title: 1980s spinning gyroscope mass loss papers

tellings.quote: privately once the late 1970s hit there are some papers still that came out in the 80s dealing with spinning gyroscopes with certain electrical and uh, other components applied to them where the spinning gyroscope would lose its, uh, would lose some of its mass.

plain: Papers from the 1980s describe spinning gyroscopes that lost some of their mass when certain electrical and other components were applied to them, in magnetically shielded labs. That is according to Dave Rossi, a guest who says aliens taught him advanced physics. He tells Michels this work went private in the late 1970s, though he names no specific paper. If true, it would hint at a way to alter weight, the kind of effect often linked to anti-gravity.
